# Ghost Kit pages

Privacy policy and support pages for the iPhone app **Beyond Haunted: Ghost Kit**,
served by GitHub Pages so Apple's App Store validator can fetch them.

- https://joshnason8-lab.github.io/ghost-kit-pages/privacy.html
- https://joshnason8-lab.github.io/ghost-kit-pages/support.html

And for the Android game **Takraw Smash** (`takraw-smash/`, written by hand; the game itself is in `takraw-game/`):

- https://joshnason8-lab.github.io/ghost-kit-pages/takraw-smash/privacy.html
- https://joshnason8-lab.github.io/ghost-kit-pages/takraw-smash/support.html

**Do not edit the Ghost Kit HTML here directly.** Those files are generated. The source
text lives in the private app repo at `web/privacy.html` and `web/support.html`;
run `python3 web/build-pages.py` there to regenerate, then commit here.

This repository is public because GitHub Pages on a free account only serves
from public repositories. Besides these pages it holds the Takraw Smash game
project (`takraw-game/`, see its README) until it moves to its own repository.
